comment: The 33 G-Max Moves, which upstream does not have. PokeAPI's move table stops at 919
(malignant-chain); there is no g-max-wildfire in the pinned CSVs and none in the live API either,
so unlike every other row in this dataset these are written by hand.
Source: Bulbapedia's G-Max Move article, read 2026-09-29. Names, owners and types are
transcribed from it; the effect prose is written here rather than copied.
`forms` is a list because Toxtricity's two forms share one move. Urshifu has one each, so those
are two entries rather than one entry naming both.
`power` is set only for the three that have one of their own. Every other G-Max Move takes its
power and its category from whichever move it replaced, so neither can be stated here and both
are worked out per Pokemon instead. See maxPowerOf in GenerateDataset.kt.

moves.name: G-Max Vine Lash
moves.effect: Damages every opponent that is not a Grass type at the end of each turn, for four turns.

moves.name: G-Max Wildfire
moves.effect: Damages every opponent that is not a Fire type at the end of each turn, for four turns.

moves.name: G-Max Cannonade
moves.effect: Damages every opponent that is not a Water type at the end of each turn, for four turns.

moves.name: G-Max Befuddle
moves.effect: Poisons, paralyses or puts every opponent to sleep.

moves.name: G-Max Volt Crash
moves.effect: Paralyses every opponent.

moves.name: G-Max Gold Rush
moves.effect: Confuses every opponent and scatters coins, which are collected after the battle.

moves.name: G-Max Chi Strike
moves.effect: Raises the critical-hit rate of the user and its allies by one stage, and stacks with itself.

moves.name: G-Max Terror
moves.effect: Stops the target being switched out, as Mean Look does.

moves.name: G-Max Foam Burst
moves.effect: Lowers the Speed of every opponent by two stages.

moves.name: G-Max Resonance
moves.effect: Weakens both physical and special damage to the user's side for five turns, as Aurora Veil does without needing snow.

moves.name: G-Max Cuddle
moves.effect: Infatuates every opponent of the opposite gender to the user.

moves.name: G-Max Replenish
moves.effect: Has a half chance of giving back a Berry the user or an ally has eaten.

moves.name: G-Max Malodor
moves.effect: Poisons every opponent.

moves.name: G-Max Meltdown
moves.effect: Stops every opponent using the same move twice in a row, as Torment does.

moves.name: G-Max Drum Solo
moves.effect: Ignores the target's Ability, and has a power of 160 whatever the base move was.

moves.name: G-Max Fireball
moves.effect: Ignores the target's Ability, and has a power of 160 whatever the base move was.

moves.name: G-Max Hydrosnipe
moves.effect: Ignores the target's Ability, and has a power of 160 whatever the base move was.

moves.name: G-Max Wind Rage
moves.effect: Clears screens, entry hazards and terrain from the target's side of the field.

moves.name: G-Max Gravitas
moves.effect: Intensifies gravity for five turns, as Gravity does.

moves.name: G-Max Stonesurge
moves.effect: Scatters Stealth Rock on the target's side of the field.

moves.name: G-Max Volcalith
moves.effect: Damages every opponent that is not a Rock type at the end of each turn, for four turns.

moves.name: G-Max Tartness
moves.effect: Lowers the evasiveness of every opponent by one stage.

moves.name: G-Max Sweetness
moves.effect: Cures the user and its allies on the field of their status conditions.

moves.name: G-Max Sandblast
moves.effect: Traps the target in a sandstorm for four or five turns, as Sand Tomb does.

moves.name: G-Max Stun Shock
moves.effect: Poisons or paralyses every opponent.

moves.name: G-Max Centiferno
moves.effect: Traps the target in fire for four or five turns, as Fire Spin does.

moves.name: G-Max Smite
moves.effect: Confuses every opponent.

moves.name: G-Max Snooze
moves.effect: Has a half chance of making the target drowsy, so that it falls asleep at the end of the next turn.

moves.name: G-Max Finale
moves.effect: Heals the user and its allies by a sixth of their maximum HP.

moves.name: G-Max Steelsurge
moves.effect: Scatters sharp steel on the target's side, which hurts a Pokemon switching in by as much as Steel damages it.

moves.name: G-Max Depletion
moves.effect: Takes two PP from the last move the target used.

moves.name: G-Max One Blow
moves.effect: Hits through protection, Max Guard included.

moves.name: G-Max Rapid Flow
moves.effect: Hits through protection, Max Guard included.
